invariant: every eligible species must retain all 35 A/M worlds after 90s positive conditioning
reason: each 90s focal-positive node is an A anchor, so its minimum A distance is zero under every non-open A threshold
each 90s focal-positive node is an M source, so it is reachable at step zero under every M horizon/barrier world
open A and open_all M are permissive by definition
consequence: calibration is conditioning/world construction, not empirical world contraction; all empirical contraction claims are reserved for 2023 positive witnesses
failure_rule: if any eligible species has calibration_survivor_world_count != 35, stop as implementation/contract failure before interpreting heldout results
